name: 読書計画の開始日の案内
prompt:
Create one crisp Japanese reading-plan milestone card as a static app UI component.
Reference 1 is the authoritative original screen. Use only the first milestone card and match its structure, visible state, proportions, and spacing. Exclude phone chrome, navigation, left timeline, later cards, and all content outside that card. Reference 2 gives the exact Japanese wording and native layout; reference 3 helps with crop/alignment. Reference 4 is the exact protected facilitator bookshelf portrait with pink ring; place it as supplied without repainting, retouching, recoloring, or replacing it.
Canvas is landscape 16:9, 390 by 220 layout, pure white. One white card at x20 y8, width350 height202, 1px very light gray border, 3px radius. Add a flat forest green top rule exactly 3px high. Leave 10px white below. No shadow, gradient, frame, heading, extra content, or decorative background.
Exact layout and copy:
- Pale mint badge x34 y22, 106 by22, radius3. A small clean forest outline rocket matching the source at x40 y27; then exact text 到達点 1 in Meiryo Regular 12px, line height16, beginning near x60 y23.
- 21日間 in Meiryo Regular 12px, line height16, right aligned at x276 y25, width80.
- 3月3日 in Meiryo Bold 14px, line height24, at x34 y68, width66.
- Thin pale gray vertical divider x102 y64, height34.
- 読み始めましょう in Meiryo Bold 20px, line height28, at x114 y66, width240.
- Exact image 4 portrait at x34 y120, 34 by34, circular with its existing pink ring fully visible.
- 進行役・ジャクリーン in Meiryo Regular 12px, line height16, at x82 y118.
- 案内役 in Meiryo Regular 12px, line height16, muted gray #6E6E6E, at x82 y142.
- ようこそ！ in Meiryo Regular 14px, line height24, at x34 y178.
Use near-black #1D1D1D primary text, forest green #174C36 for top rule and rocket, pale mint #ECFDF5 for badge, muted gray #6E6E6E for the role, white card, subtle neutral border. Keep the source hierarchy and compact Japanese native layout. Set every copy string exactly as written, with correct Japanese glyphs and no extra or missing text. Do not make all body text bold. Do not invent controls, symbols, icons, badges, borders, or cards.
reviewNotes: Outer card and vertical text anchors drift from the 390x220 native reference; exact portrait preservation is unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
